verdict.rationale: Rootly documents a public REST API with an API reference overview, key generation and role assignment (rootly-docs-24, rootly-docs-49), and API-driven incident creation (rootly-docs-11). It also publishes a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec and an API changelog with dated endpoint-level and breaking-change entries (rootly-supp-openapi-spec, rootly-supp-api-changelog, rootly-docs-91). The probe 404s only cover guessed docs-domain paths; the spec is linked at a different documented URL, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, and a spec URL that answers non-browser clients (it returns 403 to them).
